records.claim: The use of lorazepam during pregnancy can cause temporary symptoms in newborns soon after birth. These symptoms are sometimes referred to as withdrawal. Symptoms can include irritability, crying, sleep disturbances, tremors, jitteriness, trouble breathing, or muscle weakness. Not all babies exposed to lorazepam will have these symptoms. If symptoms develop, they usually go away within a few weeks and are not known to have any long-term effects for the baby. It is important that your healthcare providers know you are taking lorazepam so that if symptoms occur, your baby can get the care that is best for them.
records.source_section: I need to take lorazepam during my pregnancy. Will it cause withdrawal symptoms in my baby after birth?
